item.title: Europe looks beyond the ISS
item.description: European Space Agency member states will meet in Rome Dec. 15 to decide the future of Europe’s human and robotic exploration program. The meeting breaks with ESA’s usual three-year ministerial cycle, giving ministers an earlier opportunity to respond to the approaching end of the ISS and growing calls for Europe to secure a more autonomous role in human spaceflight and exploration.
